title: D1：强制喂入后 parser-dirty 粘滞（不得被下一块自愈）

expectations.name: next chunk does NOT clear the dirty marker (pre-fix bug)
even after the OSC terminates (BEL) the snapshot stays partial
explicit reset is the only escape and clears the dirty marker
after reset the snapshot is partial for the fresh-view reason (never auto-full)
long DCS force-fed -> partial, and still partial after ST terminates it

reset.note: explicit reset-baseline: screen cleared, a new absolute frontier is defined; history before it (including rejected ranges) is not recoverable

details.note: sticky by design: after a force-fed partial sequence the emulator parser state cannot be proven to match a clean-boundary state, so only an explicit reset-baseline may restore a trustworthy baseline (fresh-view, still partial).
